messages:
elaine: Heads up 1 BigClient SQ arrived. Key asks: KMS rotation proof, chain-of-custody for keys, RBAC change history for service accounts, and an example SIEM export for suspected data exfil. Can we run a tabletop to assemble artifacts?
ryan: I can run the tabletop. propose 30m: scenario walk, artifact list, quick demo of log export, and PR for signed manifest.
jon: Ill prepare scrubbed KMS logs and a sample rotation event. We should show fields: principal, action, key_id, old_version, new_version, request_id, timestamp.
maria: sample event line Ill include in the packet: `2025-08-12T09:12:44Z principal=svc:ingest action=RotateKey key_id=cmk-0a1b old=ver12 new=ver13 request_id=3a7f...` 1 will also add redaction rules.
sam: for RBAC history, we'll extract change deltas from rbac_audit. keep it simple: actor, role, change_type, reason, ts, request_id.
jon: example SQL we plan to share (redacted):
```
SELECT actor, target_role, change_type, reason, occurred_at, request_id
FROM rbac_audit
WHERE tenant_id = 'bigclient-prod' AND occurred_at BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-08-01';
```
ryan: note: BYOK/CMK is supported on Dedicated and Private only. add explicit deployment note.
tanya: add HSM-backed statement for on-prem customers.
elaine: good. incident angle: customer asked how we detect abnormal key usage (mass decrypts). can we show a detection rule and playbook?
jon: detection rule sample (ES): `{"query":{"bool":{"must":[{"term":{"action":"Decrypt"}},{"term":{"key_id":"cmk-0a1b"}}],"filter":{"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-1h"}}}}}}` and threshold rule: rate(count_where(action='Decrypt'),1m) > 200 -> alert.
maria: playbook snippet: 1) triage alert, 2) snapshot affected keys and sessions, 3) rotate or restrict keys, 4) export full logs, 5) notify customer + SEC.
ryan: for QSA evidence they want tamper-evidence: current pipeline writes sha256 checksum to object metadata. we'll add GPG-signed manifest for export. I'll open a small PR to add signing step.
sec-bot: reminder: tabletop-security-exercise assigned to ryan at 2025-08-14T16:00Z.
sam: retention question: default immutable storage 90d, can extend per contract. include config snippet and SLA entry.
elaine: who will join customer walkthrough? ryan (lead), jon (logs), maria (KMS), tanya (deploy/HSM), sam (RBAC).
ryan: invite out for 2025-08-15 10:00 PT and draft doc at https://redwood.internal/docs/sec/tabletop-bigclient (internal).
jon: uploaded scrubbed logs to secure share, will DM link.
maria: checklist up-to-date in drive: rotation proof, signed manifest, RBAC extract, SIEM sample, alert/playbook, screenshots. ping me for review.
elaine: after the call we capture follow-ups as tickets with P0/P1 so sales can track. thanks all :thumbsup:
